verdict.rationale: Per-employee workstation compliance tracking is a fair question for a compliance-automation platform like Thoropass, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents generic monitors over connected cloud systems (AWS, Azure, GCP) and auditor-vetted integrations. Nothing mentions an endpoint agent, an MDM integration, or per-device checks for disk encryption, screen lock or password managers, and cloud monitors are an adjacent capability that earns no credit.
